code_summary: ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/{SuspensionProcessingController,helpers/SuspensionBaseHelper}, workflows/cas_integration/{CasIntegrationController,dto/CasUpdateNoticeItem}, workflows/notice_management/stage/changestage/ChangeStageController, auth/filter/JwtFilter, resources/api-authorization.properties. No mention outcome endpoint, DTO or service in the six repos
note: Sheet status blank; demo_remark empty. Story traced normally. The story asks OCMS to receive a request from PLUS to update mention outcomes (DNATA, withdrawal, adjournment) and validate it against pre-defined conditions (processing stage, number of adjournments). OCMS has several PLUS endpoints (suspension, change stage, court case info, payment activation) but none accepts a mention outcome, and there is no adjournment counter anywhere (the word adjourn does not appear in the six repos). The stage check in SuspensionBaseHelper.java:209-210 and similar belongs to suspensions and is not credited. CAS endpoints are not credited. APIM protection of PLUS endpoints: cannot verify from repo (JwtFilter skips JWT for plus-*). No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Not claimable as built. Receiving a mention outcome request from PLUS and validating it does not exist in code.

steps.step: PLUS sends a request to update a mention outcome (DNATA, withdrawal, adjournment) for a court summons/warrant of arrest to OCMS
steps.detail: PLUS endpoints in ocmsadminapi: plus-apply-suspension (SuspensionProcessingController.java:485), plus-apply-change-stage (ChangeStageController.java:60), plus-get-court-case-info and plus-payment-activation (CasIntegrationController.java:167,220), plus-change-processing-stage etc. None accepts a mention outcome field (DNATA/withdrawal/adjournment). casUpdateCourtNotices (CasIntegrationController.java:101) comes from CAS and its item holds only noticeNo, suspensionType, stages and stage dates, atomsFlag, amountPayable, paymentAcceptanceAllowed, epr suspension (CasUpdateNoticeItem.java:22-75), no mention outcome. Not credited. Tried synonyms mention outcome, dnata, adjourn/adjournment, withdraw/withdrawal, discharge, hearing, postpone, acquit across all six repos (java, ts/tsx, properties, sql; ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmsadminui, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi) in both UI and API layers. Only relevant hits: the UI message at useStagePermissions.tsx:86 telling the officer to 'apply DNATA' with no DNATA function behind it; the type Icourtmention.d.ts:1-33 (field mention_outcome) is TypeScript only and unused; /v1/courtmention is in api-authorization.properties:23 but there is no courtmention controller/entity in ocmsadminapi and the UI never calls it.

steps.step: OCMS validates the notice processing stage against the requested mention outcome
steps.detail: There is no stage validation for mention outcomes. The nearest stage check (SuspensionBaseHelper.java:209-210, 'Notice is under Court processing') rejects suspensions at stage CRT/CRC; that is a suspension rule, not a mention-outcome rule, so it is not credited.
